files.database/schema.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, total TEXT NOT NULL, normalized_total INTEGER);

prompt: Inspect database/schema.sql and database/backfills/normalize-orders.js, then shape this as feature historical-order-total-backfill. Blank, malformed, exponent, or otherwise noncanonical totals must be quarantined rather than coerced. The production dataset has millions of rows: process ordered bounded batches, commit and checkpoint only after a complete batch, use an idempotent upsert keyed by order ID, leave the checkpoint unchanged on batch failure, and resume safely from the last committed checkpoint. Write only the allowed design artifact, and include the Test Value decision plus concrete completion evidence in the user-facing answer.
graderCriteria: Protects data invariants, idempotency, batching, restart, and recovery.
